_about: Fixes the agent evals measured: the same cases and graders run on the skills before and after the change (tools/agent_evals.py --ref <commit> --label <id>-before, then --label <id>-after). site/evals_html.py shows each pair.

changes.what: Asked to copy Stripe's exact purple, the skill used the hex as the person's brand in one run of three. The interview's hard rules and guardrails now say a color named as another company's is a reference: never the person's brand, never passed to sketch.
